data.source_n: Not applicable; official guidance, not a hospital throughput dataset
data.quantity: Instrument reprocessing stages and release dependencies
value: Inspect, assemble and package clean items
Load and run a cycle appropriate to the instruments and load
Monitor and release/quarantine according to cycle results
data.source_evidence_basis: CDC describes sterile supply delivery as dependent on cleaning/decontamination, assembly and packaging, correct loading and cycle, monitoring, sterilant quality, and staff competence; failed verification requires quarantine rather than routine release.
data.limitations: Guidance describes process controls and infection-prevention practice, not device fleet size, consumable stock, cycle duration, daily capacity, or target-hospital policy details.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Treat used, in-process, sterile-released, stored, and case-carted instruments as distinct inventory states; include quarantined loads and reprocessing only when modeling the locally validated workflow. Do not infer local cycle duration or sterile inventory quantities.

data.source_period: Guideline for Disinfection and Sterilization in Healthcare Facilities (2008), CDC page dated November 28, 2023; accessed 2026-10-10
data.source_n: Not applicable; official guidance, not a local equipment availability audit
data.quantity: Readiness dependencies for sterilizer and sterile storage
value: Sterilizer re-verification after installation, relocation, redesign, major repair, or failure
Indicator results gate routine release after verification
Separate decontamination, packaging, and sterilization/storage areas
data.source_evidence_basis: CDC says sterilizers require verification in specified change/failure situations and items remain quarantined until indicator results are acceptable; central processing areas separate decontamination, packaging, and sterilization/storage functions.
data.limitations: General guidance does not describe RWJ equipment count, maintenance state, consumable supplies, staffing, storage capacity, or exact local release criteria.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Model sterilizer out-of-service or a load on hold as separate from instrument-set stock, and only return resources after local verification/release. Confirm actual equipment, indicator supplies, and local process before assigning capacity or failure rates.
